text_block_list.text: The day of the Aoi Stakes had finally arrived—!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I slept well, and I had a solid breakfast...
Did I forget anything? ...Nope, all good.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Helios! What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy-yo! Miracle-channn!!
Super congrats on running the raceee!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A-And hold up a sec! It's not just me, y'know~?
Lemme put it on screen! Uhhh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey-heeey!
Can you see me, Miracle~?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Palmer! Are you here too?
Wait, and also—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo, Miracle-chan!
We're here too♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's finally showtime...!
Good luck, Miracle!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Ines, even Ryan...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well? Well?! It's a classmate hype cheer produced by Heli-tan!
Cheer up, Mira-sensei♡

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha! ...Yeah.
That really gave me a ton of energy."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My nerves just blew right away.
Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out.
I'll be sure to live up to everyone's kindness... just watch.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...So that's what happened.
Before we left the inn."

"She seemed wonderfully relaxed in the best possible way,
so I asked her why...
It seems it's all thanks to her wonderful friends."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Also, in addition to that... yeah.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The snack rice ball you gave me yesterday...
after our final training session before the race.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That was delicious. Really delicious.
Hehe... I think I've fallen in love
with cream cheese and bonito flakes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're helping me.
...Even now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone.
Thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all of that,
I can run with all my might today.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you results...
worthy of everything that made this possible.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'm off!
